title: 003 这样很不合理004 惨死的王姬上
content_zh:
【确定合成】
【暂时不用】
两个选择在张泱脑中清晰浮现。
她还是头一回碰见这种情况。
以往只有她伪装玩家打团下副本，搜集可合成的战利品碎片才会有这种系统提示。
张泱不假思索，心念一起选择第一个。
几个呼吸后，她感觉断肢缺口有什么东西在密集蠕动，似有万千虫蚁在上面爬过，紧跟着便是说不出的痒意与灼热传到大脑，让她不适地蹙起眉。起初还能忍，直到——
“嘶——”
缝合处传来清晰而尖锐的疼痛。
张泱下意识抬手扼住路人甲的手腕。
“停下！”
指腹下的路人甲脉搏跳动剧烈，肌肉出现一瞬僵硬，短暂对峙过后，路人甲卸掉力气松开针。张泱拽着缝线将刺入皮肉的针扯出来。
霎时，温热殷红的血从针眼汩汩流出，循着细长脖颈化成蜿蜒的血色小蛇。张泱摸了把传来清晰疼痛的位置，掌心沾上粘稠的血。
将掌心递到眼前看了好一会儿。
“是真的血……”
跟着又将胳膊抬高。
这条胳膊原先被分成了三段——
手腕到指尖、手肘到手腕、胳膊到手肘。
张泱缝合它们的时候可是费了不少力气，而现在，除了三条颜色极淡的粉痕以及皮肤沾的血，竟看不出这条胳膊曾是散装货。这条胳膊的灵活程度跟她习惯的身体一样。
她眨了眨眼，发出一声羡慕喟叹。

“原来玩家吃得这么好。”
玩家是不会死亡的，不管受了多么重的伤势，被副本机械BOSS绞成饺子馅，还是跟其他玩家大规模生死自负的械斗，他们都能在十几息后以损失一半气血的代价复活。
甚至连损失的这些气血也能靠时间自然恢复，要是玩家不愿意浪费时间可以吃药。
张泱作为PC自然没这待遇。
可现在为什么有了？
她陷入了沉思。
喃喃：“……是因为这里是家园基地？”
不是没这种可能。
张泱挑选的人类观察对象就说过，游戏官方推出家园系统的时候用过“这片天地由你做主，这个世界由你改造”、“我的家园，我的世界”的宣传语。张泱攒了多年，勤勤恳恳，下副本打劫BOSS、跑野外打劫玩家，终于凑够购买家园基地的钱，拿到了地契。
虽说还没来得及去官方登记，但——
地契已经在自己手上了。
落款也是张泱本人的名字。
她进入家园支线，这块地方就是她的家园、她的天地、她的世界，她当然有特权！
多了个玩家都有的复活技能怎么了？
如此一想，瞬间念头通达。
张泱萌生出一个猜测，为了验证自己的想法，她用那张被血泥覆盖的脸露出大大的灿烂笑容，在神秘雨夜路人甲惊悚注视下，以手成刀将左手砍断。砸在泥地上扬起一圈尘土，鲜血飞溅在路人甲的脚背。做出这疯狂举动的人弯腰将断手捡起，扬笑道：“再试试？”
“试、试试？”
张泱催促：“当然是缝合啊，来。”
content_en:
【Confirm synthesis】
【Not used for the time being】
Two choices emerged clearly in Zhang Yang's mind.
This was the first time she had encountered such a situation.
In the past, this kind of system prompt would only appear when she pretended to be a player and played in a group to join a dungeon and collect loot fragments that could be synthesized.
Zhang Yang chose the first one without hesitation.
After a few breaths, she felt something squirming densely in the gap between the severed limbs, as if thousands of insects and ants were crawling over it, followed by an indescribable itching and burning sensation that spread to her brain, making her frown in discomfort. It was bearable at first, until——
"Hiss——"
A clear, sharp pain shot through the sutures.
Zhang Yang subconsciously raised his hand to strangle Passerby A's wrist.
"Stop!"
The pulse of Passerby A under the fingertips beat violently, and the muscles stiffened for a moment. After a brief confrontation, Passerby A released his strength and released the needle. Zhang Yang pulled the sutures and pulled out the needles that had penetrated the flesh.
Instantly, warm and bright red blood gurgled out from the eye of the needle and turned into a small, winding bloody snake along the slender neck. Zhang Yang touched the area where there was clear pain, and his palm was stained with sticky blood.
He put his palm in front of his eyes and looked at it for a long time.
"It's real blood..."
Then he raised his arms again.
This arm was originally divided into three sections——
Wrist to fingertips, elbow to wrist, arm to elbow.
Zhang Yang put a lot of effort into sewing them together, but now, except for three very light pink marks and blood on the skin, it is impossible to tell that this arm was once a piece of bulk goods. The arm was as flexible as the body she was used to.
She blinked and let out an envious sigh.
“It turns out the players eat so well.”
Players will not die. No matter how seriously injured they are, whether they are crushed into dumplings by the dungeon's mechanical boss, or they engage in large-scale life-and-death battles with other players, they can be resurrected after a dozen breaths at the cost of losing half of their health.
Even the lost energy and blood can be recovered naturally over time. If the player is not willing to waste time, he can take medicine.
As a PC, Zhang Yang naturally didn't get this treatment.
But why now?
She was lost in thought.
Muttered: "...Is it because this is the home base?"
It's not impossible.
The human observation subjects selected by Zhang Yang said that when the game official launched the home system, they used the slogans "This world is yours to decide, and this world is transformed by you" and "My home, my world". Zhang Yang had been saving for many years, working diligently, playing dungeons to rob bosses, and running into the wild to rob players. Finally, he scraped together enough money to purchase his home base and obtained the title deed.
Although I haven’t had time to register with the official yet, but——
The land deed is already in his hands.
The signature is also Zhang Yang's own name.
She entered the home branch. This place is her home, her world, her world. Of course she has privileges!
What happened to the resurrection skill that every player has?
When I think like this, my thoughts suddenly become clear.
Zhang Yang came up with a guess. In order to verify her idea, she showed a big bright smile on her face covered with blood and mud, and cut off her left hand with a knife made of her hand under the horrified gaze of a passerby on a mysterious rainy night. A circle of dust was raised when it hit the muddy ground, and blood spattered on the instep of a passerby. The person who made this crazy move bent down to pick up the severed hand and said with a smile: "Try again?"
"T-try?"
Zhang Yang urged: "Of course it's sutures, come on."
